title: app.yaml
description: Packaging contract between the generated app and the pipeline/AMI build. See pipeline/CONTRACT.md.

name.description: Lowercase identifier; used as image name, systemd unit name and /var/lib/<name>.

runtime.description: AL2023 dnf packages installed into the AMI.

build.description: AL2023 dnf packages needed only to build/test; never installed into the AMI.
Shell command run at the app root in amazonlinux:2023; must produce ./dist.

units.description: The app's systemd units, relative to dist/; installed to /etc/systemd/system and enabled (see CONTRACT.md, 'systemd units').
